method: Audit-only set intersection of ARC-1 training filenames in the fixed source ZIP with current ARC2 challenge identifiers; no evaluation answers read and no IDs recorded.
interpretation: The external model README describes ARC-1 training and RE-ARC pretraining and ARC-1 training test pairs as validation; these 36 tasks have possible prior exposure and the 100-task cohort as a whole cannot be called unseen for this model.
limitations: ID overlap alone does not prove which exact tasks or pairs were used to train the released checkpoint.
Zero evaluation ID overlap does not exclude equivalent inputs, other training sources, or other exposure.
Training manifest and model weight provenance remain unverified.
next_step: Preserve the fixed cohort and pre-register an additional cohort excluding known ARC-1 training identifiers and input overlaps; do not use IDs for runtime answer selection.
